name: Digikore Studios Ltd.
summary: Digikore Studios Ltd. is an Indian-based company operating within the entertainment and media industry, specializing in visual effects (VFX) and animation. The company provides a comprehensive suite of post-production services, including high-end VFX for feature films, web series, television series, documentaries, and commercials. These services encompass animation, rotoscoping, paint, matchmove, compositing, 2D to 3D stereo conversion, virtual reality, augmented reality, and camera tracking. Digikore Studios also offers digital marketing services, OTT production, brand jingles, and AI-powered music generation. The company serves a diverse global clientele, including major Hollywood studios such as Disney/Marvel, Netflix, Amazon, Apple, Paramount, Warner Bros., and Lionsgate, as well as Indian production houses. Its primary target markets are North America, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and India, with approximately 98% of its revenue derived from international clients. The business operates on a project-based service model, utilizing its creative talent and technical infrastructure to secure long-term service contracts.
